en: The image shows a vintage, colored postcard depicting a tree-lined promenade with a circular fountain in the foreground. Benches and people are visible along the path, and there are statues and lush greenery throughout the park. The text at the top of the postcard appears in several languages (Cyrillic and Latin alphabets), mentioning 'Belgrád' and 'Kalimegdan sétatér — Kalimegdán-Promenade.'
